purpose: New editorial scenarios frozen before the 2026-10-29 ranking change. Authored by the coding agent, not independent human judgments or a held-out user study. Original 2026-10-25 labels remain unchanged.

scenarios.brief: Liked and finished Ori; seek platforming, connected exploration and traversal challenges.
Likes Slay the Spire: prioritize card-building and repeatable run-based decisions, not strategy alone.
Finished and liked Portal 2; seek puzzle-solving or spatial reasoning, not just another cooperative game.
Liked Hollow Knight: connected exploration, hidden routes and challenging traversal or combat.
Opting out of multiplayer also excludes cooperative titles, even when wishlisted and liked.
Avoiding Horror also excludes Survival Horror; the narrower label must not bypass a broad exclusion.
